metadata.title: Secondary Traces and Kummer Quotients for the Function-Field Fortune Crown
metadata.description: Replacement Paper VI and conclusion of the six-paper sequence. It constructs the fixed-class cyclotomic tangent, Hattori--Stallings divided trace, explicit Artin--Schreier irreducibility quotient, corrected Kummer forms and exact compactified point count, and isolates the remaining one-sided Frobenius/nonvanishing theorem. Internal technical package; not human peer reviewed.
metadata.notes: Neither the function-field d=1 crown nor the integer Fortune conjecture is proved. Reserve a final DOI only after external human specialist review is disposed.
